description: Reasoning Schemas & Problem-Solving Archetypes for Ratios, Rates, Proportions, Scale Drawings, Inverse Variation, and Mechanical Transmission.

archetypes.name: Part-to-Part Ratio Simplification (การทอนอัตราส่วนส่วนต่อส่วนอย่างต่ำ)
archetypes.coreConcept: Dividing both terms of a ratio by their greatest common factor preserves proportional invariance.
mentalModel: 1. Express comparison as a fraction a / b.
2. Determine greatest common factor gcd(a, b).
3. Divide both terms by GCF to obtain irreducible ratio.
archetypes.governingRelation: a / b = (a / gcd(a, b)) / (b / gcd(a, b))

cognitiveTraps.description: Subtracting terms instead of dividing by GCF.

versatileDomains.description: Comparing defect rates to passing production units.
Comparing volumetric acid to solvent proportions.

archetypes.name: Unit Rate Evaluation (การคำนวณอัตราต่อหนึ่งหน่วย)
archetypes.coreConcept: A unit rate normalizes a rate comparison to a single unit denominator: r = quantity / units.
mentalModel: 1. Identify total quantity and associated measurement units.
2. Formulate rate fraction: quantity / count.
3. Compute decimal or integer quotient to find unit rate.

cognitiveTraps.description: Inverting the division, placing units over quantity.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating kilometers traveled per liter of fuel.
Evaluating megabytes transferred per second.

archetypes.name: Direct Proportional Scaling (การคูณขยายตามสัดส่วนโดยตรง)
archetypes.coreConcept: Under constant unit rate k, the dependent quantity scales linearly: y = k * x.
mentalModel: 1. Find constant unit rate k = y_0 / x_0.
2. Multiply unit rate by new independent magnitude x_new.
3. Verify proportional consistency.

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding difference in x directly to y instead of multiplying.

versatileDomains.description: Scaling baking ingredient masses for increased servings.
Projecting brochure print counts across scheduled press hours.

archetypes.name: Proportion Cross-Product Inversion (การแก้สัดส่วนด้วยผลคูณไขว้)
archetypes.coreConcept: In any proportion a / b = x / d, the cross products are invariant: a * d = b * x <=> x = (a * d) / b.
mentalModel: 1. Set up proportion equation matching corresponding units.
2. Apply cross multiplication equality: a * d = b * x.
3. Divide by b to isolate unknown x.
archetypes.governingRelation: a / b = x / d <=> x = (a * d) / b

cognitiveTraps.description: Dividing a by d and multiplying by b.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating IV drip volume based on patient body mass.
Determining fertilizer mass required for expanded acreage.

archetypes.name: Part-to-Whole Ratio Partitioning (การแบ่งส่วนตามอัตราส่วนจากยอดรวม)
archetypes.coreConcept: A ratio a:b distributes a total sum T into parts proportional to fractional shares a / (a + b) and b / (a + b).
mentalModel: 1. Sum ratio parts: total_parts = a + b.
2. Compute value of a single part: T / (a + b).
3. Multiply single part value by requested component ratio term.

cognitiveTraps.description: Dividing total directly by ratio term b rather than sum of parts.

versatileDomains.description: Distributing shareholder dividends across share classes.
Allocating gravel and sand weights from total mix mass.

archetypes.name: Scale Factor Architectural Conversion (การคำนวณอัตราส่วนมาตราส่วนแผนผัง)
archetypes.coreConcept: A scale factor 1 : S translates miniature blueprint distances into full physical dimensions: Real = Map * S.
mentalModel: 1. Identify unit scale equivalence (e.g. 1 cm = S meters).
2. Set up scaling ratio: Map_dist / Real_dist = 1 / S.
3. Multiply drawing distance by scale factor S to determine real distance.

cognitiveTraps.description: Dividing blueprint measurement by S instead of multiplying.

versatileDomains.description: Translating drafting blueprint lengths into building spans.
Converting map distances to real mountain trail lengths.

archetypes.name: Inverse Proportion Constant Product Invariance (การแปรผกผันและผลคูณคงที่)
archetypes.coreConcept: When two variables vary inversely, their product remains constant: w_1 * t_1 = w_2 * t_2 <=> t_2 = (w_1 * t_1) / w_2.
mentalModel: 1. Recognize inverse relationship: more workers means less time.
2. Calculate invariant total workload product: W = w_1 * t_1.
3. Divide total product by new worker count w_2 to find new duration.

cognitiveTraps.description: Treating inverse relation as direct, scaling time upward.

versatileDomains.description: Determining completion hours with expanded crew size.
Calculating drainage time when adding parallel pumps.

archetypes.name: Multi-Factor Dimensional Rate Conversion (การแปลงอัตราแลกเปลี่ยนและการแปลงหน่วย)
archetypes.coreConcept: Chained conversion factors cancel unwanted units through dimensional analysis multiplication.
mentalModel: 1. Write starting quantity with initial units.
2. Align conversion ratios so numerator and denominator units cancel.
3. Compute product of unit rate factors.

cognitiveTraps.description: Dividing by conversion factor instead of multiplying.

versatileDomains.description: Converting shipping weight charges across international currencies.
Converting kilobits per second to megabytes per minute.

archetypes.name: Limiting-Component Three-Way Mixture Proportion (สัดส่วนผสมสามส่วนที่มีวัตถุดิบจำกัด)
archetypes.coreConcept: A mix needs components in the ratio a:b:c, but each component has a limited stock S_i. The limiting component (smallest S_i / p_i) sets the largest batch; that batch size then determines how much of each component is used and how much of the others is left over.
mentalModel: 1. For each component, compute the number of ratio units its stock allows: S_i / p_i.
2. The smallest value is the limiting component and sets the unit size u.
3. Largest batch = u * (a + b + c).
4. Used amounts = u * p_i; leftovers = S_i - u * p_i.

cognitiveTraps.description: Omitting the third ratio term when summing denominator parts.
Taking the component with the smallest stock (not the smallest stock-per-part) as the limit.

versatileDomains.description: Blending copper, tin, and zinc under strict alloy ratios.
Compounding medicinal cream from active agent, oil, and water.

archetypes.name: Compound Gear Train Design for a Target Output Speed (การเลือกเฟืองในชุดเกียร์ผสมให้ได้ความเร็วเป้าหมาย)
archetypes.coreConcept: In a compound gear train (gears 2 and 3 share a shaft), the first mesh is fixed. Choose the output gear from a given set of tooth counts so that the output speed is as close as possible to a target without exceeding it, then give the resulting speed. The shared-shaft speed from the first mesh feeds every candidate for the second mesh.
mentalModel: 1. First mesh: omega_2 = omega_1 * N_1 / N_2; the shared shaft gives omega_3 = omega_2.
2. For each candidate N_4, compute omega_4 = omega_3 * N_3 / N_4.
3. Keep the candidates with omega_4 <= target and choose the one closest to it.
4. Report the chosen tooth count and its output speed.

cognitiveTraps.description: Multiplying by output tooth count and dividing by input tooth count.
Adding the two mesh ratios instead of multiplying them.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating generator shaft RPM from turbine blade rotation speed.
Determining conveyor pulley rotation speed from motor gearbox.
